dialogues.speaker: Melissa
dialogues.text: Let's rest for a moment more. No hurry to head back out to sea.

dialogues.speaker: Melissa
dialogues.text: Sorry about that, but I'm currently enjoying a no-fishing season — that is to say, I'm on vacation.

dialogues.speaker: Melissa
dialogues.text: When not out at sea, one can take a stroll in the breeze, listen to the flowing water, and think about the countless souls that live alongside the fish... Interesting, no?

dialogues.speaker: Melissa
dialogues.text: It really brings to mind that one phrase, "one who sleeps with dead fish lives still, but one who sleeps with living fish..."

dialogues.speaker: Melissa
dialogues.text: It's fine. You're more than welcome to chat with me.

dialogues.speaker: Melissa
dialogues.text: Haha, don't take that so seriously. It's just a bit of a vulgar joke amongst us fisherpeople.

dialogues.speaker: Melissa
dialogues.text: I mean, the line trails off, doesn't it? Why, we could just tack on something silly like "is a Blubberbeast" or "is a Bubbly Seahorse," or something like that, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Melissa
dialogues.text: The underwater world must be a lovely place. Alas, I can't dive, so all I can do is listen to Archenoul talk about it.
